question: How does touching with argha drops purify all?
premises: all touched by argha drops becomes pure
other purity arises from shiva-sun touch
inference: The verse states that argha-drop contact purifies all, while another purity arises from Śiva-sun contact.
plain_english: All touched by drops from the argha vessel becomes pure; other purity will arise from contact with Śiva-sun rays.
